findings.title: Persistence remains tied to a marked route
findings.claim: Musa's refusal to cease is tied to reaching a named confluence, and the supplied wider returns make that persistence directional: a route and a recognized threshold remain part of what it means to reach the goal.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier أَبْلُغَ takes مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ as its destination. The supplied same-surah contacts at 18:84, 18:85, 18:89, 18:92, and 18:93 return the reaching relation through provided means, following a way, and arrival at marked boundaries; the reader walk also places the same reaching branch beside the maturity threshold at 18:82.
findings.reader_payoff: The vow becomes directional rather than merely forceful: the reader can see what the persistence is for and why the destination stays active while the route unfolds.
findings.containment: The wider contacts are contextual resonances within the supplied packet. They do not replace the geographic confluence, claim that 18:60 itself reports arrival, or make maturity the local gloss of the focus verb.

epistemic.reason: The core anchor is a trusted citable publication, while the retained path and maturity extensions come from legacy_unbound reader-walk evidence and target-side connection rows without full target morphology.

branch_activations.carrier: أَبْلُغَ carries self-attainment of the destination named by the focus clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied same-surah sequence gives means, following a way, and repeated arrivals at consequential boundaries.
branch_activations.activation: Those route-and-arrival contacts return through the focus reaching verb, so the alternative of continuing for a long time is read as movement through a route toward a marked boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The vow's persistence is directional and route-dependent; desire alone does not constitute the completion of reaching.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection does not claim that every journey has the same destination, or that the focus verse has already reached its confluence.

findings.title: Duration answers to the carried sign
findings.claim: The long-duration alternative in حُقُبًا remains answerable to a concrete sign carried behind: the later forgotten fish turns extended forward travel into time that is corrected by what the travelers failed to notice.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairs the duration carrier with the alternative of proceeding after the reaching goal. The supplied reader walk identifies a provision carried to the junction, left behind, and then remembered as the cue for retracing, while the trusted publication states that the duration is adjusted by this material marker.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why a long horizon does not by itself locate the goal: the journey becomes legible through the material trace that interrupts and redirects it.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual resonance. It does not fix حُقُبًا to a numeric duration, make it literally name a bag, or generalize every lost object into a rule of guidance.

epistemic.reason: A trusted citable finding supplies the focus-anchored duration claim, while the carried-and-forgotten sign and retracing sequence come from legacy_unbound reader-walk evidence; no selected context unit supplies full target morphology.
